trial_court: II Additional Subordinate Judge, Tirunelveli, in A. S. No. 147 of 1978
facts_of_case: Plaintiff filed suit for maintenance after being beaten and treated cruelly by defendant, who then married a second wife. Plaintiff was not aware of defendant's income at the time of notice.

legal_principles.principle: There can be desertion by the husband even though the wife and the husband are living in the same house.
legal_principles.held: Desertion has been considered by the Courts and under the provisions of Ss. 9, 10, 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, XXV of 1955.
applicable_acts_sections: Hindu Adoptions and Maintenance Act — Section LXXVIII
cited_cases: Maharaja Nadar vs Muthukani Ammal, (1985) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: If the husband has reasonable cause for leaving the wife, there can be no desertion.
legal_principles.held: There can be no desertion if the husband has reasonable cause for leaving the wife.
cited_cases: Maharaja Nadar vs Muthukani Ammal, (1985) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A wife does not forfeit her claim to separate maintenance if she has any of the grounds for separate living mentioned in this clause.
legal_principles.held: This clause lays down that the wife does not forfeit her claim to be separately maintained if she has any of the grounds for separate living mentioned in this clause.
cited_cases: Maharaja Nadar vs Muthukani Ammal, (1985) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: A wife's refusal to maintain was considered an offence under Hindu Law.
legal_principles.held: Refusal to maintain was considered to be an offence under Hindu Law. Manu declares (***)
cited_cases: Maharaja Nadar vs Muthukani Ammal, (1985) X SCC Y

outcome.result: Appeal preferred against judgment and decree dated 30-1-1979
outcome.final_order: Plaintiff entitled to maintenance, including past maintenance and a charge upon schedule mentioned property from defendant.

keywords: Latin maxim: Ubi Jus Non Permittit Quod Rectum Dictat
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for maintenance under the Hindu Marriage Act
advising on divorce proceedings involving allegations of cruelty
assisting in drafting a response to a petition for divorce
